title: Norwegian Language Learning Overcoming Mistakes and Building Confidence

cards.front: Det var litt flaut.
cards.back: It was a little embarrassing.

cards.front: Det var litt stressende.
cards.back: It was a little stressful.

cards.front: Det mest effektive er å snakke.
cards.back: The most effective thing is to speak.

cards.front: Hvorfor sier jeg dette til dere?
cards.back: Why am I telling you this?

cards.front: Jeg har også vært i den situasjonen.
cards.back: I've also been in that situation.

cards.front: Jeg kan bare noen få ord.
cards.back: I only know a few words.

cards.front: Jeg klarer ikke engang å lage en setning.
cards.back: I can't even form a sentence.

cards.front: Det er viktigere å bare prøve.
cards.back: It's more important to simply try.

cards.front: Ikke vær så redd for å gjøre feil.
cards.back: Don't be so afraid of making mistakes.

cards.front: Du kommer til å gjøre feil.
cards.back: You're going to make mistakes.

cards.front: Det handler om å akseptere at du kommer til å gjøre feil.
cards.back: It's about accepting that you're going to make mistakes.

cards.front: Du kan ikke alltid lage perfekte setninger.
cards.back: You can't always form perfect sentences.

cards.front: Uttalen er ikke perfekt.
cards.back: The pronunciation isn't perfect.

cards.front: Grammatikken er feil.
cards.back: The grammar is wrong.

cards.front: Skjønner du?
cards.back: Do you understand? / Do you see what I mean?

cards.front: Jeg høres dum ut.
cards.back: I sound stupid.

cards.front: Det blir flaut.
cards.back: It'll be embarrassing.

cards.front: Folk kommer til å le av meg.
cards.back: People are going to laugh at me.

cards.front: De ler ikke av deg.
cards.back: They're not laughing at you.

cards.front: De synes ikke du er dum.
cards.back: They don't think you're stupid.

cards.front: Kanskje du gjør en feil som er morsom.
cards.back: Maybe you make a mistake that is funny.

cards.front: Han var ny i Norge.
cards.back: He was new to Norway.

cards.front: Han hadde glemt igjen kameraet sitt på bussen.
cards.back: He had left his camera behind on the bus.

cards.front: Jeg har mistet kameraet mitt.
cards.back: I've lost my camera.

cards.front: Jeg har mistet kameraten min.
cards.back: I've lost my friend.

cards.front: Hva heter kameraten din?
cards.back: What's your friend's name?

cards.front: Til slutt forstod de.
cards.back: Eventually they understood.

cards.front: Han forstod hva han hadde sagt.
cards.back: He understood what he had said.

cards.front: Han lærte forskjellen veldig raskt.
cards.back: He learned the difference very quickly.

cards.front: Da blir det ikke noe snakk.
cards.back: Then there won't be any conversation.

cards.front: Da får du ikke snakket norsk.
cards.back: Then you don't get to speak Norwegian.

cards.front: Da blir du bare stille.
cards.back: Then you just become/stay quiet.

cards.front: Du stopper deg selv.
cards.back: You hold yourself back.

cards.front: Jeg gjør feil av og til.
cards.back: I make mistakes from time to time.

cards.front: Jeg kan ta feil.
cards.back: I can be wrong / I can make mistakes.

cards.front: Jeg har ikke hørt det ordet før.
cards.back: I haven't heard that word before.

cards.front: Jeg uttaler det feil.
cards.back: I pronounce it incorrectly.

cards.front: Jeg har ikke lært det ennå.
cards.back: I haven't learned it yet.

cards.front: Hvorfor skal jeg kunne det perfekt med en gang?
cards.back: Why should I be able to do it perfectly straight away?

cards.front: Det er ikke naturlig.
cards.back: That's not natural.

cards.front: Vær snill med deg selv.
cards.back: Be kind to yourself.

cards.front: Ikke vær så hard mot deg selv.
cards.back: Don't be so hard on yourself.

cards.front: Ikke vær så streng med deg selv.
cards.back: Don't be so strict with yourself.

cards.front: Bare prøv å snakke.
cards.back: Just try to speak.

cards.front: Det er ikke noe farlig.
cards.back: It's nothing dangerous / It's no big deal.

cards.front: Det går bra.
cards.back: It's okay / It'll be fine.

cards.front: Tør å snakke norsk.
cards.back: Dare to speak Norwegian.

cards.front: Det er ingen krise hvis du tar feil.
cards.back: It's not a disaster if you're wrong.

cards.front: Det er helt naturlig.
cards.back: It's completely natural.

cards.front: Det er en del av læringen.
cards.back: It's part of the learning process.

cards.front: Du må lære av feilene dine.
cards.back: You have to learn from your mistakes.

cards.front: Du blir mye flinkere.
cards.back: You'll become much better.

cards.front: Du blir mye flinkere når du snakker norsk.
cards.back: You'll become much better when you speak Norwegian.
